description: Maps DLC story-demo message IDs to their spoken voice lines; two numbered table shards share one row schema.

Id.simple: Message/text ID that keys the voice mapping.
Id.technical: FName primary key. Show-message commands match this value against the displayed message ID; script preload walks all rows and matches it against the script message IDs in order. Export spells it ID.

Id_Voice.simple: VoiceDataTable row to play for that message.
Id_Voice.technical: FName joined to VoiceDataTable. The command parser resolves it to a Voice row and queues that row's CueSheetName/CueName with the message delay and voice slot; script preload resolves it to add the voice cue sheet to the load set. A missing Voice row leaves no queued voice or cue sheet.

notes: Loaded as two DataTable primary assets, DlcStoryDemoVoiceDataTable1 and DlcStoryDemoVoiceDataTable2, appended to DTM.DlcStoryDemoVoiceDataTables (+0x790). Both shards use FGameDataTableRow_DlcStoryDemoVoice and are searched as one array, first hit wins.

DLC script contexts use this table instead of StoryDemoVoiceDataTable for both message parsing and cue-sheet preload. The level-sequence evaluator checks it after the standard table and overwrites the standard voice with the DLC row when both match.
Companion exports contain 200 rows in shard 1 and 863 in shard 2; this is available content, not a retail completeness claim. Sources are reconstructed retail C++.

usages.detail: Resolves both DLC shards into DTM.DlcStoryDemoVoiceDataTables.
Collects DLC story voice rows for message parsing.
Preloads the cue sheet of the first matching DLC row.
